stories.title: SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
stories.brief: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

stories.title: SpaceX successfully catches top of huge Starship rocket for first time
stories.brief: The rocket stage was caught mid air using huge mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

stories.title: Islamabad hosts foreign dignitaries for two-day ECO ministerial meeting
stories.brief: Foreign dignitaries arrived in Islamabad on Sunday as Pakistan hosts the two-day 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) Council of Ministers, starting today.

stories.title: In call with Fazl, Bilawal condemns 'govt actions, political vengeance' against JUI-F
stories.brief: PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari on Sunday spoke to Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman and condemned the “government’s actions” against him.

stories.title: Officials from Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Turkiye arrive in Islamabad for 30th ECO ministerial meeting
stories.brief: Mr. Elnur Mammadov, Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Azerbaijan and Head of Delegation, arrived in Islamabad to participate in the 30th ECO Council of Ministers Meeting.

stories.title: Gatherings in KP's Bajaur, Lakki Marwat, Swabi, Tank banned for 30 days
stories.brief: The notification formalising the restriction, seen by Dawn, said Bajaur Deputy Commissioner (DC) Adnan Farid Afridi approved the restrictions in view of the law and order situation, citing the need for additional measures to safeguard public life and property and maintain peace.

stories.title: Section 144 imposed in Lakki Marwat, Bannu for one month amid security concerns
stories.brief: Authorities in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's Lakki Marwat and Bannu districts imposed Section 144 for one month, banning public gatherings, protests, and several other activities, citing concerns over the law and order situation, emerged on Sunday.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz, CDF Munir top world's 500 most influential Muslims list
stories.brief: The report listed the five leaders in three entries, with the prime minister and the field marshal jointly representing Pakistan.

stories.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
stories.brief: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

stories.title: Emotional Rory McIlroy dedicates record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title to father
stories.brief: ‘He said: “Go and win the Race to Dubai.” This is for him’McIlroy’s father, Gerry, is recovering after major surgeryAn emotional Rory McIlroy dedicated a record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title to his father, Gerry, who is recovering from major surgery in the United States.

stories.title: 160 questions, only one wrong: top scorer in South Korea tax exam admits AI cheating
stories.brief: Fears for national college entrance exam next week as test taker admits sending photos of questions to AI toolThe marks attained by the top scorer ⁠on South Korea’s national exam for aspiring tax accountants this year seemed too good to be true.

stories.title: Dominant Australia defeat New Zealand in Men's World Cup final
stories.brief: Australia win a fourth successive Men's Rugby League World Cup, beating New Zealand comfortably in the final in Brisbane.

stories.title: Tearful McIlroy dedicates record-equalling win to ill dad
stories.brief: Rory McIlroy wipes away tears as he dedicates his record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title to his ill father, Gerry.

stories.title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left the company in August 2025
stories.brief: Megaspeed said on Sunday that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, whose ties ​to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang have raised US national ‌security concerns, officially left the company on August 30, 2025, and has no current role there.

stories.title: Top scorer on South Korean tax exam confesses to cheating with AI
stories.brief: It ​has also raised the stakes for organisers of South Korea's high-stakes annual college ​entrance exam this Thursday. The scandal has rattled a country where standardised tests largely ‌dictate ⁠social mobility and career trajectories, coming just four days ahead of Thursday's annual national college entrance exam.

stories.title: Peshawar ATC moves to declare Sohail Afridi proclaimed offender in Radio Pakistan attack case
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: An anti-terrorism court here has started proceedings to declare dysfunctional Chief Minister Sohail Afridi as a proclaimed offender in the Radio Pakistan attack case as the relevant police official claimed that Mr Afridi couldn’t be traced.

stories.title: Dar responds positively to Egypt's invitation for PM Shehbaz to visit Cairo
stories.brief: The foreign ministers of Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye last met on the sidelines of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York on September 22 to discuss regional developments and efforts to promote peace and stability.

stories.title: ATC moves to declare Afridi absconder
stories.brief: The court ordered issuance of notices under Section 87 of the Code of Criminal Procedure after police submitted a report stating the two nominated accused could not be located.

stories.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
stories.brief: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.

stories.title: Australia crush New Zealand to win fourth Women’s Rugby League World Cup
stories.brief: Australia dominated the first half and capitalised on the Kiwi Ferns’ errors to win 34-10 and clinch the trophy.
